sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: HIMACS has added five colourways to its terrazzo-inspired collection, which have received a prestigious Red Dot Design Award 2026 in the product category. The HIMACS Terrazzo collection reimagines a timeless material technique through rich textures, a carefully balanced colour palette and distinctive, mineral-inspired patterns.
